Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 104. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the
following benefits:
Your speed increases by 10 feet.
When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain
doesn’t cost you extra movement on that turn.
When you make a melee attack against a creature,
you don’t provoke opportunity attacks from that
creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or
not.
